sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: *Mikor* means “when”. Like *ki*, it goes first and the verb follows right behind it: *Mikor olvasol?* means “When do you read?”

sections.title: Answering
sections.content: Answer with a time word first, as you did in unit 13: *Reggel olvasok.* The time words are *reggel*, *délután*, *este* and *most*. A one-word answer is enough: *Reggel.*

items.english: When does Anna walk? – She walks in the afternoon.
When does Károly cook? – He cooks in the evening.

sections.content: *Mikor?* needs a time (*reggel*), *Hol?* needs a place (*otthon*). Check the question word before you answer.
